verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer a developer API and official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an SDK, API, or developer library. The QuickBooks/Xero sync, the Plaid connectivity and the llms.txt file are integrations or adjacent features, not official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
